text:
Maya CS: Heads-up: Verdant Health renewal meeting scheduled Tue 10am PT. Need an SLO + onboarding evidence packet for execs — uptime windows (90/30/7d), p50/p95 latency, incident log, and a pre-filled credit calc if they qualify. Can we assemble?

Ethan SRE: I'll pull the SLO exports and incident timeline. Will include rolling windows and raw samples. ETA today EOD.

Maya CS: Great. Also include the runbook we delivered during onboarding and the enablement slide deck + recording links. Execs want a 1-page summary.

Priya Onboard: I have the runbook and slides. Will export attendance CSV for each session and flag modules Verdant missed.

Jordan Sales: FYI Verdant called out renewal sensitivity to credits. They asked last quarter what threshold triggers a credit. We should show the contract math and an example calc.

Olga Legal: Reminder: contract specifies 30-day lookback for credit eligibility and caps credits at three months' service. I'll review the calc before it's sent.

Ethan SRE: Quick SLO snapshot from our internal tool:

```
90d uptime: 99.93%
30d uptime: 99.98%
7d uptime: 99.99%
p50 response: 115ms
p95 response: 430ms
incidents (90d): 1 - regional degradation, 18 minutes (Jan 12)
```

Ethan SRE: Generated export command I ran:

```
redwood-slo export --customer verdant --ranges 90d,30d,7d --metrics uptime,p50,p95 --format csv > verdant_slo_export_1768889999.csv
```

incidents-bot: Created ticket CS-4689 with SLO export artifacts (https://redwood.internal/tickets/CS-4689)

Maya CS: Priya — can you annotate which enablement sessions Verdant skipped? They said they missed the "prompt engineering clinic" and the "ops runbook walkthrough".

Priya Onboard: Confirmed. I'll add notes to the deck and attach attendance CSV. Also will mark recommended catch-up sessions and available dates.

Liam Product: That Jan outage was related to a model-variant fallback we introduced. We have a customer-safe blurb that explains mitigation and the rollback steps we took. Happy to include it.

Nora CS: I'll draft the 1-pager for the execs (SLO summary, incident highlight, credit calc example, next steps). Jordan — can you review pricing/contract angle before we send?

Jordan Sales: Yep, will review the proposed credit amount and messaging. Keep the email concise and include remediation steps and an offer for a follow-up enablement.

Olga Legal: Please include the contract clause reference in the credit calc doc. I'll sign off once that's present.

Maya CS: Proposed timeline: artifacts compiled by Mon 3pm PT, internal review by 5pm, customer email Tue 9am PT. Does that work?

Ethan SRE: SLO export + incident timeline by 2pm. Will attach CSVs to ticket.

Priya Onboard: Slides, recordings, attendance CSV by 1pm.

Jordan Sales: I can review credit calc by 4pm.

Olga Legal: I'll review legal language by 5pm.

Nora CS: Draft 1-pager and email by 3:30pm for review.

Maya CS: Thanks all. Once internal review is done, I'll post the pack and loop Sam (account lead) before we send. Sam prefers a one-paragraph summary + one recommended remediation item.

Jordan Sales: Also suggest we propose two slots for a follow-up enablement in the email; makes it easier for execs to commit.

Maya CS: Good idea. Priya will propose slots in the pack.

Ethan SRE: Added an attachment note in the ticket: verdant_slo_export_1768889999.csv, verdant_incident_1768889999.log, runbook_verdant_v1.pdf

Maya CS: Perfect. I'll assemble and close the loop in this thread when the pack is ready. :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
